definition: חֲשַׁשׁ noun masculine Isa 59:24 chaff ; — absolute תֵלְדוּ ׳ תַּהֲרוּ ח קַשׁ Isa 33:11 ye conceive chaff, ye bring forth stubble (figurative of vain attempt of Assyr.); construct לֶהָבָה ׳ ח יִרְפֶּה Isa 5:24 (|| קַשׁ ) as flaming chaff sinketh down (simile of perishing of heedless Judahites). חֻשָׁתִי see חושׁ . חַת , חִתָּה see חתת .
